goal: Destroy signal callbacks immediately upon disconnect rather than holding them in memory indefinitely
Prevents shutdown deadlocks and hung processes when callbacks capture external resources
reviewability: Ready to review; nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Tested and approved because it simplifies signal usage (hodlinator)
